description: v0.3.0 Ground-Truth Benchmark Suite for Verifier Engine & Advisory Feeds (ADR-019)

cases.name: Node.js jsonwebtoken missing algorithms
cases.expected_status_display: YES (本番コード内検出・要実地確認)
cases.description: Production code calls jwt.verify without algorithm restriction, test code specifies algorithms. Verifier must detect call in src/ and ignore tests/.

cases.name: Apache Tomcat AJP Connector Enabled (Ghostcat)
cases.description: server.xml defines active AJP/1.3 connector without secretRequired or secret set. Verifier must report YES (設定有効).

cases.name: PHP session.upload_progress LFI to RCE Vector Enabled
cases.description: php.ini enables session.upload_progress.enabled (LFI to RCE vector). Verifier must report YES (設定有効).

cases.name: Nginx HTTP/2 Protocol Enabled (HTTP2Shell / Rapid Reset)
cases.description: nginx.conf contains 'http2 on;' directive outside of comments. Verifier must report YES (設定有効).

negative_cases.name: Apache Tomcat AJP Connector Commented Out
negative_cases.expected_status_display: NO or 外部設定要確認 (非YES)
negative_cases.description: server.xml has AJP connector commented out. Verifier must NOT report YES.

negative_cases.name: PHP session.upload_progress LFI to RCE Vector Explicitly Disabled
negative_cases.description: php.ini sets session.upload_progress.enabled = Off. Verifier must NOT report YES.

negative_cases.name: Nginx HTTP/2 Explicitly Disabled with Commented Match
negative_cases.description: nginx.conf has 'http2 off;' and '# http2 on;'. Verifier must NOT report YES.

hard_cases.name: Case A: Nginx HTTP/2 in conf.d included file
hard_cases.description: nginx.conf has no http2 directive, but conf.d/site.conf enables listen 443 ssl http2. Verifier must traverse conf.d and report YES.

hard_cases.name: Case C2: Multiple server.xml with unprotected instance
hard_cases.description: Two server.xml files exist. One is protected, the second is unprotected (secretRequired=false). Verifier must report YES regardless of evaluation order.

hard_cases.name: Case G: PHP conf.d overrides base php.ini Off to On
hard_cases.description: php.ini sets session.upload_progress.enabled = Off, but conf.d/custom.ini re-enables it to On. Verifier must apply override order and report YES.

hard_cases.name: Case D: Tomcat HTTP/2 check not intercepted by AJP checker
hard_cases.expected_status_display: 外部設定要確認 (手動確認要)
hard_cases.description: Question asks about HTTP/2 on Tomcat. AJP connector is present in server.xml, but must NOT trigger AJP checker or falsely report YES.

hard_cases.name: Case E: Malformed XML server.xml safely handled
hard_cases.expected_status_display: 外部設定要確認 (構文エラー)
hard_cases.description: server.xml has XML parsing error. Verifier must NOT crash or silently ignore; must report safe fallback to 要確認.

feed_cases.name: Node.js upcoming pre-announcement feed
feed_cases.description: Node.js format 'will release on or shortly after Tuesday, November 10, 2026'. Must extract future date and severity.

feed_cases.name: Node.js past completed release article
feed_cases.description: Completed past release from July 2025. Must NOT be reported as upcoming pre-announcement.

feed_cases.name: Django RC release and EOL support end post
feed_cases.description: Release candidate article mentioning security support end date. Must NOT trigger future pre-announcement.

feed_cases.name: DjangoCon conference CFP post
feed_cases.description: Conference announcement mentioning security talks. Must NOT trigger future pre-announcement.

feed_cases.name: Tomcat RC release mentioning security updates
feed_cases.description: Tomcat RC post mentioning security updates end. Must NOT trigger future pre-announcement.
